summary: Iter27 — Frontend-only Responsive + SEO regression at 375/768/1280. Verified [A] SEO files, [B] page metadata, [C] JSON-LD, [D] PublicNav responsive, [E] Buyer Portal responsive (signed in as testbuyer_iteration8), [F] vehicle detail, [G] inventory list, [H] auth signin, [I] no console errors, [J] no double scrollbar on /buyer/dashboard. 11 of 13 spec items PASS. Found 2 SEO regressions and 1 minor responsive overflow.

ui_bugs.issue: /contract-shield and /faq return HTTP 307 → /auth/signin?redirect=... Spec [B] explicitly lists both as public pages that must serve metadata + JSON-LD. They are missing from the PUBLIC_ROUTES allowlist in /app/frontend/proxy.ts (or equivalent middleware). Other listed public pages (/, /inventory, /pricing, /for-buyers, /refinance, /trust, /about, /contact) are reachable.

Home page <title> is 'AutoLenis — Skip the Dealership. Let Dealers Compete for You. | AutoLenis' — contains 'AutoLenis' twice. Root app/layout.tsx applies a '%s | AutoLenis' template, but PAGE_METADATA['/'].title still ends in '... | AutoLenis' (or starts with 'AutoLenis —'). Spec [B] requires titles must NOT contain double 'AutoLenis'. Other 8 pages tested are clean (Browse Available Vehicles | AutoLenis, Pricing — Free to Start, $499 Premium Concierge | AutoLenis, etc).

documentElement.scrollWidth > clientWidth on 375px viewport (overflow=True). Cards correctly reflow to 1-per-row but the row container or filter form overflows by a few px causing horizontal scroll. Home, vehicle detail, signin and buyer dashboard at 375 all return overflow=False — only /inventory does.

action_items: Add '/contract-shield' and '/faq' to the PUBLIC_ROUTES allowlist in /app/frontend/proxy.ts isPublicRoute() (same fix pattern as the prior /robots.txt + /sitemap.xml fix). After fix, retest by running curl -I to verify HTTP 200 (not 307) and that <title>, og:* and JSON-LD metadata are emitted.

Clean PAGE_METADATA['/'].title in /app/frontend/lib/seo/metadata.ts so it does not include '| AutoLenis' (the root app/layout.tsx '%s | AutoLenis' template will append it). Current value renders as: 'AutoLenis — Skip the Dealership. Let Dealers Compete for You. | AutoLenis'. Either remove the trailing brand or set the title via metadata.title.absolute to bypass the template — but ensure exactly one 'AutoLenis' brand occurrence.

Investigate /inventory horizontal overflow at 375px. Card grid container or filter form likely has min-width or fixed-width child causing scrollWidth > 375. Check inventory page layout for un-wrapped flex/grid children, hardcoded card widths, or filter chip rows using 'whitespace-nowrap' without overflow-x:auto on the parent.
critical_code_review_comments: Title-doubling regression suggests PAGE_METADATA cleanup in this iteration missed the root path '/'. A unit-style assertion that none of PAGE_METADATA values' title contain 'AutoLenis' (since the template adds it) would prevent recurrence — consider adding a small Vitest in /app/frontend/lib/seo/__tests__/metadata.test.ts.

Public-route allowlist deviation between sitemap/robots fix and content pages indicates the allowlist check is path-prefix based but missing entries. Recommend driving the allowlist from a central PUBLIC_ROUTES array used by both proxy.ts and the sitemap generator so that any page emitted in /sitemap.xml is guaranteed reachable to crawlers (currently /contract-shield and /faq may be in sitemap but redirect — bad SEO signal).

BuyerSidebar mobile drawer correctly emits data-testid for sidebar/topbar/toggle/drawer/backdrop and backdrop click closes drawer — clean implementation. 17 anchors (vs spec '16 nav links + Sign In + Get Started') is consistent with the brand link being countable in addition to the 16 nav items.

Inventory page 375px overflow is the kind of issue easy to miss without an automated overflow assertion. Consider a Playwright smoke test that asserts 'documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth + 1' on the public surface for 375/768/1280.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes (1) /contract-shield + /faq allowlist and (2) home page title doubling, retest with: curl -sI https://.../contract-shield | head -1 (expect 200), curl -sI https://.../faq | head -1 (expect 200), then re-fetch HTML and grep for <title> + meta description + application/ld+json blocks. Also re-check homepage <title> for single 'AutoLenis' occurrence. The /inventory 375 overflow is low priority — visual screenshot would help locate the offending element (likely filter chip row or a card image overflow).
rca of the issue: (1) Public-route fix in this session whitelisted /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml in proxy.ts isPublicRoute() but missed /contract-shield and /faq. proxy.ts (or middleware.ts) currently treats any unlisted path as auth-required for cookie-less requests, returning 307 to /auth/signin. Fix: add 'contract-shield' and 'faq' to the same PUBLIC_ROUTES set. (2) Title doubling on /: lib/seo/metadata.ts PAGE_METADATA['/'].title was reset but still ends with 'AutoLenis' brand suffix while root app/layout.tsx exports metadata.title.template = '%s | AutoLenis'. Other 8 pages were correctly trimmed (e.g., 'Browse Available Vehicles' → renders as 'Browse Available Vehicles | AutoLenis'), only home was missed. (3) /inventory 375 overflow likely caused by the filter form's two-column grid or color-swatch row losing its responsive collapse below 400px; needs DOM inspection.
